# DJ VII TORIA

> Swedish-Jamaican female DJ, music producer and DJ coach based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Open-format sets for yachts, hotels, weddings, clubs and corporate events across the UAE, Oman and Europe.

- Website: https://www.djvii.com/
- Booking: WhatsApp or phone +971 50 237 5736, email Djviitoria@gmail.com, or "Plan your night" on https://www.djvii.com/#book
- Press kit (PDF): https://www.djvii.com/press-kit.pdf
- Also known as: VII TORIA, DJ VII, DJ Viitoria, Victoria Graham
- Based in: Dubai, UAE (UAE residence, own car, own DJ controller)
- YouTube: 28K+ subscribers, over 3 million views

## Questions and answers

### Who is DJ VII TORIA?
DJ VII TORIA (Victoria Graham) is a Swedish-Jamaican female DJ, music producer and DJ coach based in Dubai, UAE. She plays open-format sets for yachts, hotels, weddings, clubs and corporate events, and her YouTube channel has 28K+ subscribers and over 3 million views.

### What music does she play?
Open format, read to the room: Afrobeats, Amapiano, house and Afro house, R&B and hip-hop, Arabic and oriental, disco house, pop, dance, soul and 80s to 2000s hits.

### Where has she played?
Across Dubai and Abu Dhabi at venues such as VII and Dalida Lounge at Conrad Dubai, Sea Fu at Four Seasons, Waldorf Astoria, SLS Dubai, Address Sky View, Bab Al Shams and Formula 1 weekends in Abu Dhabi, plus gigs in Oman, Thailand and Italy.

### What events can I book her for?
Yacht parties, hotel and pool days, club nights, weddings, private parties, brand launches and company parties, from intimate dinners to 500+ guests.

### Does she bring her own equipment?
Yes. She has her own DJ controller and her own car, and can bring speakers when the venue has none. She holds UAE residence.

### Does she travel outside Dubai?
Yes. She plays in Abu Dhabi and across the UAE, and travels to Oman and abroad on request.

### Does she give DJ lessons?
Yes. She teaches at Smart Gate DJ School in Dubai and gives private DJ lessons.

### How do I book DJ VII TORIA?
Use "Plan your night" on this page to send your request on WhatsApp or by email, or contact her directly on +971 50 237 5736 or Djviitoria@gmail.com. She usually answers the same day.
